quiet_account.eventDescription: A company found on Greenhouse or Lever with no open roles right now. Confirms the ATS and that the account is not currently hiring.

active_account.eventDescription: A company with open roles: open-role count, departments hiring, locations, senior-role count, newest posting, and sample titles. A live hiring signal on the account.

hot_account.eventDescription: A company scaling fast: at or above the hot threshold of open roles, with the full department and location breakdown. A strong buying trigger. The first hot account per run is free so you can validate output.
